title: RF / detector board (RF_HMC, RF_HF, RF_INJECTOR, DC_CORE) 184 x 44.5 - routed CI model with impedance coupon
note: W2 PCB-RF-1 placed every RF-domain ref and scripted the RF50 copper; W2 PCB-RF-2 adds the scripted GND vias, the SENSE copper, the BOND-RF plated hole and the coupon and routes the rest with Freerouting. Written by build/kicad/boards/RF/rf_layout.py (edit the layout there, then rerun it). Nothing here is a fabrication release; bench gates stay OPEN.

contract_transform.why: board_gen frame (contract (0, 0) at KiCad (100, 100 + 44.5)); the coupon outlines below the board would move an Edge.Cuts bounding-box origin

layers.source: contract stackup JLC04161H-7628, 4 layers, 1.6 mm (mechanical/generated/contract/boards.json stackup; build/15); RF50 geometry from pcb/generated/netclasses.json (L1 over L2, h 0.2104 mm)

plan.F.Cu: all parts, RF50 CPWG (scripted, locked), signals, GND pour (coplanar ground)
plan.In1.Cu: solid GND reference plane under RF50 (layer type power: the router puts only vias through it)
plan.In2.Cu: second solid GND plane (layer type power)

rules_note: rules_file stays null (pcb/board_gen.py does not copy .kicad_dru files yet); the net classes RF50 0.36/0.20, DCTAP 0.20/0.30 (project rule, not IPC-verified), PWR1A 0.35/0.15, the project classes DCSENSE 0.20/0.30 and SCRIPTED 0.30/0.15 and the default 0.20/0.15 live in RF.kicad_pro (graph class values from pcb/generated/netclasses.json). Project zone defaults (used by the board_gen pours): clearance 0.20 (= RF50 CPWG gap), minimum width 0.25, thermal gap 0.25, spokes 0.30. min_hole_to_hole 0.45 = JLC pad hole-to-hole floor (via to via 0.2); the ENC value 0.5 refused 0.6/0.3 vias at 0.15 mm clearance. min_resolved_spokes 1: a THT GND pin keeps a single spoke where the pour reaches it from one side (SMD GND pads connect solid, tht_thermal pours). RF_TAPER rule areas are not drawn: without a rules file KiCad enforces no class width, and pcb/check_boards.py takes the HMC pin tapers from rf50_taper.

fab_floor.min_hole_to_hole_note: 0.45 = pad hole-to-hole of different nets; via hole-to-hole is 0.2

list.source: one RF board per device (mechanical/params/boards.json RF; contract placement default)

instances.spares_source: no spare stated for the RF board (mechanical/params/boards.json RF)

zones.why: solid L2 GND under the RF50 CPWG (power layer, a plane in the DSN)

post_route_zones.why: coplanar ground of the CPWG; SMD GND pads solid, THT pins with spokes

height_zones.why: footprints carry no body heights; the enclosure height check belongs to the mechanical model (fit-report)

router.why: RF50, the SENSE nodes, GND and CHASSIS are scripted and complete pad to pad, so the router leaves them (locked copper that crosses a pad is no connection for it: route run 42416865216 listed the HMC pin entries as unrouted); fan-out off: its escape stubs were necked down to 0.12 mm (route run 42416865216, track_width / connection_width)

warning_checks.footprint_filters_mismatch: schematic-parity check; per-board PCBs are not linked to the multi-sheet schematic, so DRC runs without --schematic-parity and the source-pad audit replaces it
warning_checks.missing_tuning_profile: no length-tuned nets and no tuning profiles on this board
warning_checks.tuning_profile_track_geometries: no length-tuned nets and no tuning profiles on this board
warning_checks.generic_warning: KiCad's catch-all warning class; any instance is listed in report.json and reviewed
warning_checks.silk_over_copper: legend only: the fab clips legend over exposed copper; the vendored PEC11R outline (tools/make_footprints.py) crosses its own A/C/B pads
warning_checks.silk_overlap: legend only: overlapping legend items are cosmetic; every instance is listed in report.json

rf_copper.label: scripted copper of W2 PCB-RF-2 (rf_copper.py); counts are CI/model geometry
rf_copper.epad_vias_source: project choice: 2 x 2 vias 0.6/0.3 at +/-0.425 mm in the 1.7 mm HMC7992 exposed pad, one in the A407 pad; the ADI HMC7992 data sheet (https://www.analog.com/media/en/technical-documentation/data-sheets/hmc7992.pdf) was not readable 2026-11-07 (connection reset; the Farnell copy https://www.farnell.com/datasheets/2283884.pdf timed out), so its evaluation-board via pattern is TBD and the array is not claimed to follow it
open: solderable GND land and mask opening for a shield can over each HMC section: only the via ring is drawn; the land waits for a can MPN (none chosen, A-PCB-06 decision)
via plugging / tenting of the exposed-pad vias (solder wicking) is an order-time fab option, not set here

coupon.why: impedance coupon on a breakaway part of the RF panel (A-PCB-06 decision): two RF50 CPWG thru lines, 50 and 25 mm board edge to board edge between Molex 73251-1153 edge SMAs (the J409-J412 land), same stackup, lamination and etch as the board; TDR / S21 of the 25 mm difference is a bench measurement (OPEN)

tracks.why: coupon RF50 CPWG thru line, 50 mm board edge to board edge (scripted, locked)
coupon RF50 CPWG thru line, 25 mm board edge to board edge (scripted, locked)

decisions.topic: Shield can over the HMC sections
decisions.choice: no can fitted in this revision; a GND via ring per HMC section is drawn (rf_copper hmc_ring_vias), the solderable can land waits for a can MPN
decisions.reason: STACK.md names an optional shield wall or lid; a ring costs only copper and invents no MPN (A-PCB-06 decision)

decisions.choice: breakaway coupon of the RF panel: two RF50 CPWG thru lines 50 and 25 mm (edge to edge) between Molex 73251-1153 edge SMAs on two outlines below the board, in the same board file and fab set
decisions.reason: same lamination and etch as the board (A-PCB-06 decision); two lengths give the per-length loss and the launch by difference; board_gen draws the coupon after the SES import, so the router never sees it

decisions.choice: top edge (y 44.5), beside the U.FL ports, instead of the bottom edge [100,184]
decisions.reason: the 73251-1153 body reaches 9.5 mm beyond the board edge (footprint courtyard -14.29 to -4.76 mm local), while RF.r0 is 0.4 mm from rfbay.wall.bottom (mechanical/generated/fit-report.md); beyond the top edge the bay has 18.3 mm (bay inner height 62.7 from y 99.1; board top at enclosure y 143.5). The V4L SMA ends sit at board x 81.6 (arrangement b), so J410/J411 at x 65-123 keep the cables short. MODEL reasoning; MECH must model the SMA overhang (OPEN).

decisions.topic: Board ends that the graph lacks
decisions.choice: U.FL lands (KiCad 10.0.7 U.FL_Hirose_U.FL-R-SMT-1_Vertical, the land of GR-2 J423-J427) as pilot placeholders PH401-PH406; the CHASSIS end is the plated BOND-RF hole H5
decisions.reason: design/** is outside PCB-RF-1/-2; the boundary audit reports them provisional until GR-4/SRC-2 add the refs

decisions.choice: bottom edge x 120-171, openings to the edge
decisions.reason: harness routes S03/S04 reach the RF bottom edge at board x 163.3 and 167.5 (mechanical/generated/harness-routes.json)

decisions.choice: x 132-152 in three channel blocks (UHF, LBAND, HF top to bottom), the reference and reference-good blocks to the right; per block the two TLV3012 face each other (IN- / IN+) under the divider, filter and clamp, so the SENSE node is short
decisions.reason: the prototype positions (generate_routed.py:25-44) span 59 x 67 mm for 2-layer routing and do not fit the 44.5 mm board; the channel parts are kept together and the scripted SENSE copper stays below the prototype SENSE length; the 12 bleeds stay at the ports, outside the DC_CORE keepout (DC-01, DC-02)

decisions.choice: H5 plated, 3.2 mm hole with a 7.0 mm CHASSIS land on every layer and open mask; NT401 at its edge
decisions.reason: one GND-CHASSIS tie at the screw that bonds the RF board to the chassis (parts DB NT-RF-CHASSIS)

decisions.choice: scripted and locked: RF50, GND (fan-outs, fences, rings, stitching, pours), the SENSE nodes and CHASSIS; Freerouting 2.5.0 routes the rest on F.Cu and B.Cu only (In1/In2 are power layers)
decisions.reason: keeps the L2 reference solid under every RF50 line (no inner tracks), keeps the router from necking down or re-routing scripted nets, and makes the RF-critical copper reproducible from the spec

decisions.choice: project class DCSENSE 0.20/0.30 for the three SENSE nodes: the F.Cu GND pour keeps 0.30 mm around them over the solid In1.Cu GND (guard), like the DCTAP project rule
decisions.reason: DC-02 asks for a clean low-leakage SENSE layout; 0.30 is the DCTAP project rule (not IPC-verified)
